title: Synthetic guest linear-memory ceilings
method: Planning model: 32 MiB linear-memory cap per instance × 8/16/32 instances. Runtime, host buffers, stacks, compiled code and queued inputs are excluded. This is not measured density or a full process budget.
alt: Synthetic guest linear-memory ceilings. Eight instances: 256 MiB; Sixteen instances: 512 MiB; Thirty-two instances: 1024 MiB. Illustrative inputs.
